newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina promises $2 bln bond details Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Argentina promises $2 bln bond details Wednesday.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said he will give details of a planned $2.0 billion global bond this Wednesday.
"We will have news about the amount and the maturities on Wednesday," he told the daily La Nacion in an interview.

Market sources said last week that Argentina planned a global bond in two tranches with five- and 20-year maturities, priced relative to outstanding Argentina 2001 and 2003 global bonds. Merrill Lynch is tipped as lead manager.
